verdicts.reason: Field-reprogrammable logic stayed a specialist component. FPGA revenue was about $9.8 billion in 2020, around 2% of the semiconductor market, used in telecom, aerospace, industrial and some data-centre accelerators (Microsoft Bing from 2014, Azure from 2018). Consumer and everyday devices do not ship with user-reconfigurable hardware. Provisional, window closes 2031.
verdicts.mainstream_test: 50% of new units in an everyday device category. Actual: FPGA about $9.8 billion (2020), roughly 2% of chip revenue; no everyday device category ships with reconfigurable logic.
verdicts.reading: Chips whose hardware logic can be reconfigured after manufacture (FPGA-type reconfigurable computing) becoming standard in everyday computing devices. FPGAs themselves were already routine in telecom and embedded systems in 2012, so that reading cannot be the forecast.

evidence.title: Field-programmable gate array (Wikipedia)
evidence.shows: FPGA market $5.4 billion (2013), about $9.8 billion (2020); Microsoft used FPGAs for Bing from 2014 and Azure from 2018; main uses are telecom, automotive, aerospace, industrial.

verdicts.reason: Apart from blood-forming stem cell transplants, which date back decades, stem-cell treatments remain experimental. As of 2024 the only FDA-approved stem cell therapies are haematopoietic products; regenerative uses for heart, neural, diabetes and orthopaedic disease are still in trials, while hundreds of unproven clinics draw FDA warnings. Provisional, window closes 2031.
verdicts.mainstream_test: 20% of target patients receiving approved regenerative stem-cell therapy. Actual: only haematopoietic stem cell products are FDA-approved (2024); share for other conditions effectively 0%.
verdicts.reading: Regenerative stem-cell therapies for common diseases and injuries, beyond the established bone-marrow transplant.

evidence.title: Stem-cell therapy (Wikipedia)
evidence.shows: As of 2024 HSCT is the only FDA-approved stem cell therapy; most other applications are experimental; over 550 unproven US clinics by 2016.

verdicts.reading: Materials derived from or grown by living organisms (bioplastics, mycelium, bio-based composites) replacing conventional materials.

evidence.title: Bioplastic (Wikipedia)
evidence.shows: Bioplastics represented about 2% of global plastics output as of 2018.

verdicts.reading: Generating electricity from human movement (walking, joint motion) to power wearables and portable devices.
